ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Students will be required to attend a proctored exam the week of July 5th and August 2nd, either on campus or at an approved location. Clarification of the assessment notations listed above: graduate students will be assessed $309 per credit hour; undergrad students will be assessed $277 per credit hour. All students will be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are in addition to the campus range assessments if students also take an on-campus class.
